name: SVG Tech Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: SVG Tech Group Co.,Ltd., established in 2001 and based in Suzhou, China, changed its name from SVG Optronics Co., Ltd. in June 2018. The company specializes in the creation and distribution of advanced optical films and devices. Its primary market is China, where its offerings are integral to display, lighting, and capacitive touch panel applications. A significant portion of its portfolio is dedicated to optical security products and solutions. This includes specialized packaging films for mobile phone glass textures, micro-nano optics integrated into security papers, and comprehensive brand protection systems utilizing optical films. They also supply holographic and special ironing films, hot-stamping foils for decorative and security purposes, various diffractive patterns, and silver-like optical films and papers. Furthermore, SVG Tech delivers high-level optical security solutions, such as active matrix optical security films. In the realm of display and lighting technologies, the company provides a range of innovative "ultra-touch" devices. These encompass three-dimensional displays, iVTP capacitive touch panels, ultra-thin light guide plates (LGP) and associated films, and smart table ultra-touch-pads. Other offerings include micro-lenticular lenses for 3D displays, LED lighting guide plates for automotive welcome pedals, micro lens array optical films, and solutions for smart furniture and enterprise IT focused on interactive and gesture-based applications. Beyond finished products, SVG Tech also develops and supplies nanopatterning lithography equipment and materials. Their offerings here include laser graphic writing equipment, axis and micro pattern generators, various nano-devices and materials, and advanced holographic mastering systems. They provide customized micro-nano optics, the iEngraver for LGP molding, precision molding services for LGP and display components, and hologram/mask preparation, alongside sensing technology. These diverse products and solutions find widespread application across critical sectors such as micro-nano fabrication, display technologies, advanced holographic packaging and printing, optical security, and micro-optics.
